package.name: scan_core
package.description: ROS-independent sensing algorithms (pure Python: numpy/scipy/pyyaml) for the VC nano 3D-Z (12/24) large line profiler groove scan: path generation with the motion envelope, URDF kinematics, counter-based clock model, 3D reconstruction, groove model and seam estimation (1G core), cross sections and the multi-pass weld plan, calibration helpers and synthetic data. No dependency on rclpy.
